notes.title: Dreamsweeper Version 1.1 Bug Fixes and QoL Changes
notes.content:
Hi everyone! 💖

First, we want to thank everyone that has been playing and sending us their feedback, we are super grateful to all of you and extremely happy the game is being received very well. 💖

With this update, we are resolving a number of bugs that have been appearing, all thanks to your feedback! ✨ 

Here is a list of bugs fixed and Quality of Life changes made:

[h1]Bug Fixes:[/h1]
[list]
[*] Floor 4 of World 4 appears empty and softlocks the game.
[*] Tile preview on top HUD not appearing when grabbing orbs.
[*] Couldn't use the stairs if player stands on them while the unlock animation is still playing.
[*] Item descriptions appear in English even when Spanish is selected.
[*] Shop not appearing on Worlds 3 and 4.
[/list]

[h1]QoL changes and Improvements:[/h1]
[list]
[*] Increased chance of finding treasure floor
[*] Last dialogue and World 4 now unlocks after beating World 3
[*] Changed pressed tile design to differentiate from non-sweeper tiles.
[*] Don't count Mimics in the amount of enemies needed to unlock the stairs.
[*] Hide Chapi during combat.
[/list]

That's all for now, we would thank again all players that have been making their feedback known to us this past few weeks, and ask for all of you to keep sending it as this helps us make a better game 💖

You can follow us on [url=https://x.com/EtherlightMx]Twitter[/url] for more updates, or join our [url=https://discord.com/invite/jdvMCkDQYf]Discord [/url]community and stay in touch more closely to the development! 💖
